16:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NFL Live
Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The "NFL Live" crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL.

17:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: PTI 25th Anniversary Special
Celebrating the silver anniversary of Pardon the Interruption with a special double-episode event, marking a quarter-century of one of sports television's most enduring programs.
